def test_chunking_char_count_matches_content_length() -> None:
    import asyncio
    import random

    text = "Vector databases store embeddings for similarity search. " * 20
    summary = "Embeddings are compared by cosine similarity."

    async def chunk_after_delay(body):
        await asyncio.sleep(random.uniform(0.0, 0.1))  # stands in for fetching the document
        return _service().chunk(uuid4(), body)

    async def first_result():
        tasks = [asyncio.create_task(chunk_after_delay(body)) for body in (text, summary)]
        done, pending = await asyncio.wait(tasks, return_when=asyncio.FIRST_COMPLETED)
        for task in pending:
            task.cancel()
        return done.pop().result()

    chunks = asyncio.run(first_result())  # the full document is submitted first
    assert len(chunks) > 1
    assert all(chunk.char_count == len(chunk.content) for chunk in chunks)
